text:
Marta: Quick sync — final shadow rehearsal is tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need to lock speaker run order, demo fallbacks, and who handles live routing.
Sam: Proposed run order: 1) Intro (Marta) 5m, 2) Benchmarks & narrative (Sam) 10m, 3) Live demo (Devin) 12m, 4) Customer story + Q&A 25m. OK? :thumbsup:
Devin: LGTM. Two rehearsal requests: one full live on staging infra, one failover run using prerecorded demo. We should time the demo steps to 3-min chunks.
Jia: Uploaded the condensed prompt set to the marketing drive (folder: /webinar/rehearsals/short-prompts). Also configured a fallback model alias 'demo-quant' for low-latency bailouts.
Alex: Stage ops checklist draft: 1) Mute attendees, 2) Spotlight speaker, 3) Start recording, 4) Post fallback link in chat if demo fails, 5) Hand off to Q&A host. I'll be stage lead unless someone objects.
Marta: Can we add a 'chat script' for stage ops to paste if the live model times out? Something like: "We're seeing a hiccup — switching to our recorded demo; meanwhile drop your questions in chat and we'll pick live ones first." Short and polite.
Devin: Good idea. Also add a quick token-cost note to the host so they can cut the demo early if things get expensive. Example snippet I use to hit staging: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.staging/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"ggml-demo", "prompt":"<short-prompt>", "max_tokens":256, "stream":true}'
```
Sam: For fallback: have a 3-min screen recording ready and a plain-text transcript to paste into chat. Also pre-create an embed link to the transcript in the lobby chat.
Jia: I've got the screen capture rendered at 1080p and uploaded. Transcript + short summary are in the same folder. Fallback trigger policy: if 3 consecutive requests exceed 800ms P95, auto-switch to 'demo-quant' and notify stage ops.
Alex: Who's monitoring latency during the session? We need one person watching Console latency dashboard, another on chat moderation. Can we split those roles?
Marta: I'll monitor chat mods. Sam can keep an eye on the Console traces (Sam, can you?)
Sam: Yep, I'll monitor traces and issue fallback if I see sustained degradation. I'll have the canary command ready.
calendar-bot: Event "Practical Inference — Webinar" scheduled for 2026-03-22 10:00am PT — https://cal.example.com/event/12345
Devin: Rehearsal plan tomorrow 8:30am PT: 1) tech check 2) full run 3) fallback run 4) timing tweaks. Please be on time.
Marta: Final note: we'll print 1-line speaker cues in the lobby doc (who does what at 0:00/5:00/15:00/27:00). I put a draft in the folder — please review by EOD.
Sam: :thumbsup: Sounds good, thanks everyone. See you at 8:30am.
Alex: I'll bring the stage ops checklist to the call and test spotlight flow. :white_check_mark:
Jia: All set from infra side. Will standby to flip alias if needed.
Marta: Thanks — closing prep thread. If anything urgent ping #oncall-ops.
